name: labretriever
description: MCP server for querying genomic datasets via labretriever VirtualDB. Exposes SQL query tools over DuckDB views built from HuggingFace-hosted Parquet datasets.

labretriever_config.title: VirtualDB config file
labretriever_config.description: Path to your VirtualDB YAML configuration file. See https://cmatkhan.github.io/labretriever/virtual_db_configuration/ for the format. For the BrentLab yeast collection, download https://github.com/BrentLab/tfbpshiny/blob/main/tfbpshiny/brentlab_yeast_collection.yaml and provide the local path.

hf_token.title: HuggingFace token
hf_token.description: HuggingFace API token. Only required for private or gated repositories. Leave blank if all your datasets are public.
